graph.title: Wayanad Landslide Monitoring System
graph.description: A system for monitoring environmental parameters to support early identification of landslide-prone conditions.

graph.title: Campus Resource Booking System
graph.description: A web application for booking classrooms, laboratories and other institutional resources.

graph.title: Smart Agro-Climatic Sensor Network for Wayanad Coffee Plantations
graph.description: Demonstration record: Low-power mesh sensor deployment for microclimate tracking, soil moisture profiling, and frost alerts tailored for high-altitude hill agriculture.

graph.title: Kabini River Basin Water Level Early Warning Alert System
graph.description: Demonstration record: Ultrasonic depth telemetry combined with predictive hydrological runoff models to warn downstream riverbank communities during peak monsoon.

graph.title: Malayalam Dialect Speech Recognition for Tribal Health Access
graph.description: Demonstration record: Acoustic fine-tuning of automated speech recognition models to transcribe local regional dialects for primary healthcare assistance.

graph.title: Hybrid Solar-Micro-Hydro Campus Energy Management System
graph.description: Demonstration record: Supervisory SCADA controller balancing collegiate rooftop photovoltaic generation and backup storage units with dynamic load shedding.

graph.title: GECW Digital Central Repository & E-Thesis Archive
graph.description: Demonstration record: Open-access academic publication and capstone repository facilitating peer review, plagiarism verification, and institutional indexing.

graph.title: Autonomous Forest Trail Inspection Rover for Wildlife Corridors
graph.description: Demonstration record: Ruggedized tracked chassis navigating rugged terrain with edge computer vision to detect fence breaches and human-wildlife encounters.

graph.title: Federated Hospital Record Exchange for District Clinics
graph.description: Demonstration record: Privacy-preserving cryptographically verified ledger mechanism permitting tamper-evident transfer of patient health summaries.

graph.title: Smart Rainwater Harvesting & Greywater Recycling Controller
graph.description: Demonstration record: Automated pneumatic multi-stage filtration monitor regulating campus hostel auxiliary water supplies based on meteorological forecast data.
